receipt.equivalence_review: Correct closed-world refusal. The author inspected broad power, switch, voltage and monitor records and the INA219 part, not merely an empty category search. I checked the pinned TL431 REF/cathode connection, fixed grounded INA219 address pins, and ground-referenced MOSFET/flyback topology: none provides two separately monitored and selectively bled cells with the required thresholds. USB power remains available. All requirements and exact output bytes are preserved.

refusal.reason: The queried pinned catalog supplies no eligible block implementing independent two-series-cell voltage monitoring and selective 50 mA bleeding of the higher cell above 4.10 V with stop below 4.05 V across 3.0–4.2 V per cell. Actual power and monitoring contracts were inspected: INA219 blocks expose shunt/bus sensing with fixed grounded address pins but no bleed actuation; the low-side-switch block contains a ground-referenced MOSFET, flyback diode and gate bias, not a 50 mA cell bleed load or upper-cell level-shifted control; the TL431 reference has REF tied to cathode and fixed approximately 2.5 V reference behavior, not the required cell thresholds. USB-C 5 V sink entry is available, but cannot satisfy the missing cell_balance function. Replacing the pack by one cell or monitoring only pack voltage would violate the brief.
